title: AUBADE
description: Leave at dusk. Wake somewhere else. An overnight-sleeper landing page where the page is the train window: scroll becomes lateral travel through five flat colour-field legs of the night, with the Simplon tunnel as the set piece.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · React 19 · SVG · Lenis

sections.title: Header
sections.summary: (fixed): the lockup; nav links in mono (The Line, Berths, Dining car, The Night, Departures) with **one dawn indicator that glides** between links (transform `translateX` + `scaleX`) and follows hover and the active section; and a claret "Reserve a berth" button. It compacts after 80px (blurred nuit backdrop), hides on scroll-down and returns on scroll-up. A 1px rail at the bottom fills with page progress, and a small claret train rides it. On phones a toggle (☰ → ×) opens a full-screen claret panel through a `clip-path: circle()` from the toggle. Links stagger in, body scroll is locked, focus is trapped, and Escape closes the panel.

sections.title: Hero
sections.summary: an eyebrow ("Paris 19:12 → Venezia 09:48 · Thursdays & Sundays"); the h1 "Leave at dusk. / Wake somewhere else." with two masked lines that overlap the window; a lead; a magnetic claret CTA and a ghost "See the line" button; and a big rounded **window showing the dusk scene**, which glides on its own (layer loops of 34–220 s, the sun sinking over 14 s, paused off-screen). A **linen window blind lifts** on load. A "Next departure" plaque shows the first departure with berths left. Below are four facts: 1,128 km · 9 · 38 · 14 h 36.

sections.title: The Line (the mechanic)
sections.summary: a 560vh track with a sticky 100svh stage holding the window, an enamel plaque (leg n of 5, from → to, title), a clock and km readout, the leg's note, a **timetable rail** (8 stations, dots at their positions, a claret train that slides along, a dawn fill) and controls (prev and next buttons, plus a range input labelled "Travel the line").
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Berths
sections.summary: (linen field, blinding down over the night): three tilt cards in nuit, sapin and claret. Voiture 3 · Couchette Privée, "A berth of your own", 190 × 80 cm, €390, 12 cabins. Voiture 5 · Cabine, "Two, stacked", 2 × 190 × 80 cm, €640, 16 cabins. Voiture 7 · Grand Lit, "The double", 200 × 140 cm with a private shower, €1,180, 10 cabins. Fares are per cabin, with dinner and breakfast included. Each card has a 4:3 photo, specs, a price and "Choose this berth" (which pre-selects the form).

sections.title: Dining car
sections.summary: (sapin): the title, a lead, a 3:2 photo (blind wipe plus scroll parallax), count-up stats (2 seatings · 38 covers · 24 mo Comté) and a timed menu (19:40, 20:30, 21:15, 22:40, 07:10, 08:30) whose vertical rule draws in.

sections.title: The Night
sections.summary: three sticky full-height colour cards (claret 21:30 Turndown, nuit 00:00 The quiet hour, dawn 08:15 The bell), each with a huge Gloock time and a 4:5 photo. As the next card covers one, it scales to .94 and dims (`--cover` from one rAF loop).

sections.title: Departures
sections.summary: (nuit): month tabs (November 2026, December 2026, January 2027) with a gliding indicator and arrow-key support, and a departure board table (date, departs, arrives, berths, status, Reserve →). Every Thursday and Sunday is listed, with deterministic availability (open, few left, complet). 24 Dec is "Réveillon dinner on board" and 31 Dec is complet ("Arrive for Capodanno"). Rows slide in the direction of the month change, and every character **split-flaps** in (`rotateX(-90deg)` → 0, staggered).

sections.title: Reserve
sections.summary: (linen): a **live ticket** on the left (a claret band with the mark, 19:12 → 09:48, date, berth, Voiture · Cabine, guests, name, and a fare stub) and the form on the right: a departure select grouped by month (complet nights disabled), berth radio cards, a guests segment (two is disabled for the couchette), floating-label name and email fields with a drawn check when valid, and optional notes (280 characters max). Validation is client-side and tested. Invalid fields shake once and their messages slide down. Submit morphs to "Coupling the carriages" with a shuttling dot, then the form is replaced by a nuit success panel; the ticket tilts, is **punched twice** and **stamped "Validé"** with a spring. No network request.

sections.title: Footer
sections.summary: (claret): a gliding marquee of station names (it pauses off-screen, on hover and on focus), the slogan set huge, the lockup with an address, links, timetable footnotes, and "AUBADE is a fictional rail company".
